sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact September 28 announcement describes an upgrade over Sonnet 5, lower task cost, faster output and comparisons with Opus 5.5. It gives no nominal total or active parameter count and does not identify a publicly sized base; performance and serving comparisons do not establish a size-preserving lineage.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact-model specifications identify claude-sonnet-5-5, release, context/output limits, input/output modalities and API capabilities. No total or activated-parameter specification appears in the model table; effort settings control inference behavior rather than disclose model size.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full 148-page official PDF text from the parent’s fresh October 27 retrieval. Sections 1.1 and 1.4 describe pretraining/post-training and the final released snapshot without naming a publicly sized base. Exact count and lineage searches found no nominal total or active count. Table 8.1.A reports benchmark scores; effort-parameter mentions and safeguard/distillation classifiers are not model-size disclosures.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: First-party article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable, and are not provided to users. Used for distribution status.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial service terms reserve intellectual-property rights except as expressly stated. Together with the explicit nonpublic-weight policy, this supports the descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing. The document pipeline extracts text and converts pages to images. Sonnet 5.5 is active in its exact model specifications and explicitly supports PDF in its feature page.

sources.title: What's new in Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Exact model feature list explicitly supports PDF, vision, and server-side and client-side tools. Adaptive thinking is enabled by default; between_tools disables up-front thinking. Auto tool choice and strict tool inputs are supported, while forced tool choice is unsupported.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Sonnet 5.5 summary
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and read the exact Sonnet 5.5 summary. Its architecture/training section describes pretraining followed by post-training, with no nominal count, activated count or named sized-base relationship. Comparisons with Sonnet 5 and Opus 5.5 are capability and safety results.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full later 144-page official PDF text from the parent’s fresh October 27 retrieval. Exact Sonnet 5.5 comparison rows, including Table 8.1.A, contain capability scores, not total or active parameter columns. Full-text parameter, billion/trillion, activation and lineage searches disclose no count for Sonnet 5.5.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The directory lists the September Sonnet 5.5 card and subsequent October Haiku 5.5 card; used to identify and inspect the later first-party comparison material.

sources.title: Model Migration Guide - Migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Opened and directly retrieved October 27, 2026. The Sonnet 5.5 section identifies succession from Sonnet 5 and the same tokenizer, context and output limits. These compatibility facts do not identify a sized base or disclose total/active counts. No size is inferred from tokenizer compatibility, pricing or version succession.

name.note: Exact official display name and API identifier.

developer.note: The exact system card identifies Anthropic as developer.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the exact system card designation as a Sonnet-class model.

release_date.note: Announcement and specifications agree on the general-release date; this is not a training snapshot date.

open_weights.note: The explicit Claude nonpublic-weight policy applies to this model; hosted availability alone is not the basis.

license.note: Descriptive classification for nonpublic weights offered under commercial service terms, not a named open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-model numeric and named-base searches plus original and later first-party review found no developer-published nominal total or size-bearing lineage. The exact card describes pretraining and post-training without naming a publicly sized base. Sonnet 5 succession and the same tokenizer do not establish size. Null reflects absent nominal evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-parameter searches and separate review of the exact and later Haiku 5.5 comparison tables found no nominal active count or activation convention. Tables report benchmark scores; effort levels and lower task cost do not determine active parameters. No equality with total or non-embedding counts is assumed.

architecture.note: No explicit architecture in the inspected exact-model and later comparison sources. Internal-activation probes do not establish Transformer or dense/MoE structure. No architecture is transferred from another Claude model or an earlier checkpoint.

modalities.note: Text/image input and text output are explicit. PDF is a supported document format processed into text and page images, confirmed for this exact active model.

reasoning.note: Dedicated adaptive thinking is enabled by default, with configurable effort; between_tools can disable up-front thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact model documentation supports server/client tools and auto tool choice with structured strict inputs. Forced tool choice is unsupported.

patch.notes: Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; no size-bearing base relationship is documented. Architecture remains undisclosed. Proprietary describes nonpublic weights accessed under commercial terms. PDF input is document processing through text and vision. Adaptive thinking is enabled by default, and auto tool choice is supported.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh launch, specifications, transparency, migration and exact/later-card checks. No nominal count, activated-parameter table or supported sized-base lineage was found; succession, tokenizer compatibility and efficiency do not establish size. All unrelated field assessments are preserved.
